schema_description: ONE example domain — synthetic e-commerce schema (six tables under `public`: users, products, categories, product_categories, orders, order_items) defined in `schemabrain/eval/fixtures/ecommerce.sql`. E-commerce was chosen because its tables are universally legible, NOT because SchemaBrain is e-commerce-specific. SchemaBrain is a generic semantic layer for ANY production database; author your own `golden_sets/<your-schema>.json` for your real schema and pass it via `schemabrain eval --golden`.

questions.question: Where do we store user contact information like email addresses?
Which table tracks individual orders placed by customers?
How can I find the line items inside a single customer order?
Where do we keep product prices and SKU codes?
Where is the parent-child hierarchy of product categories modeled?
Which table maps each product to one or more categories?
How do I look up the registration date of a user account?
Where is the lifecycle status of an order recorded?
Where do I find how many units of a product were purchased in an order?
How can I compute total revenue from a given customer over time?
